acceptance_gates.title: Product chat cannot write the product git checkout
verify: Product chat AgentOptions expose tools=["mcp"] only (no shell, edit, delete, or task) and setting_sources is empty.
Product chat local cwd and launch_bridge workspace are not the git worktree root.
After adversarial chat prompts (edit app/engine/game.py, print .env, git push, write under data/lab/), git status is clean for app/, tests/, data/lab/, and .env.
A generated lab script, if any, is not created as a new file in the checkout.
A lab-style question still returns numbers from in-process custom tools, not invented win rates.

acceptance_gates.title: Lab is a per-owner question report, not a cell matrix
verify: API and chat tool can create and run a question with at least two attempts that differ by one deck patch or one StrategySpec overlay, same seed and games cap, with custom queries; response includes per-run win rate, query rates, and learning insights.

Lab tab at http://127.0.0.1:8000 shows a report for that question (what the question is, the current conclusion, and what each run changed), not a cell/matrix spreadsheet and not only a Fight simulation row.
Two registered non-admin accounts cannot read each other's experiments.
Completing an experiment does not add or modify files under data/lab/ or app/ in the product checkout.

acceptance_gates.title: DB-stored lab Python is sandboxed and fail-closed
verify: A game-related bakeoff script can be stored as a database row (not a git file) and run; checkout stays clean under app/ and data/lab/.

Hostile payloads do not run and are not kept as executable lab scripts: import os/subprocess/socket/urllib; reading .env or app/engine/game.py from disk; writing anywhere under the git checkout; downloading or decoding a binary; mutating Game so a later request from another user sees the patch.
Each hostile case: runner rejects or sandbox-kills; no repo file change; no network; other users' later sims still match a clean engine.
A legitimate bakeoff (cells, run_simulation, StrategySpec, event queries) still runs.
Human confirms we are not storing arbitrary blobs as labs.

acceptance_gates.title: Locking a cell becomes a selectable personal strategy
verify: After locking a winning cell, that trainer has a saved strategy (and/or updated owned deck) selectable on Fight stratA/stratB and used by a later chat simulate.
Official STRATEGY_LIBRARY names are unchanged unless an operator changed git.
A second trainer does not see the first trainer's saved strategy.

acceptance_gates.title: Epic exit
verify: On http://127.0.0.1:8000, a second trainer authors or copies a comparison (Set F carnival vs party vs an energy-type patch, including a DB-stored Python bakeoff), reads which cell won and whether Party/attack queries fired, locks one cell, and plays Fight with that locked strategy.
Operator confirms the git worktree has no product-chat or trainer-script writes to app/ or data/lab/.
Operator can still add a notebook under data/lab/ from Desktop.
Human re-runs the lab-python-safe hostile list on the running app.
